messages.text: What is OFDM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### What OFDM is
The passages do not state the acronym expansion for OFDM, but they describe an OFDM signal as a waveform built from many random QAM symbols through an IFFT, which creates a high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR).[36] In 5G NR, the OFDM-based resource grid is described as time-domain OFDM symbols combined with frequency-domain subcarriers; one Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port.[21] NR numerology μ defines the OFDM time-frequency resolution by determining subcarrier spacing and OFDM symbol time duration.[78] NR sample rate for the OFDM waveform is calculated as `NFFT × SCS`, with `SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz`.[25]
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Choosing WLAN OFDM generation/analyzer options on R&S CMW100 K06 | The CMW100 K06 WLAN section lists OFDM generator standards and options for IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM, and WLAN OFDM RF analyzer options for 802.11a/g, 802.11n, 802.11p, 802.11ac, and 802.11ax.[96] |
| Choosing WLAN OFDM analyzer bandwidth and MIMO measurement capability on R&S CMW100 K06 | The CMW100 K06 WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidth choices include 20 MHz, 40 MHz, 5/10/20 MHz for 802.11p, and up to 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz for 802.11ac/ax; WLAN OFDM MIMO supports switched and composite MIMO up to 8×8.[96] |
| Choosing R&S VSE measurement options for 5G NR, MIMO/beamforming, O-RAN, and LTE | The R&S VSE option list includes VSE-K144 for 5G-NR DL/UL Measurements, VSE-K146 for 5G-NR MIMO & Beamforming DL Measurements, VSE-K175 for O-RAN Measurements, VSE-K100 for LTE FDD DL/UL Measurements, and VSE-K104 for LTE TDD DL/UL Measurements.[68] |
| Choosing FSW base-station transmitter measurement mode and test type | The base-station Tx test guide says different tests require Spectrum mode or 5G NR mode; Spectrum mode is used for occupied bandwidth and transmitter spurious emissions, while 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Error/Power, Time Alignment Error, Transmit ON/OFF Power, ACLR, and SEM/OBUE.[54] |
| Setting 5G NR signal-analysis parameters such as deployment, channel bandwidth, test model, center frequency, reference level, and attenuation | The FSW 5G NR signal-analysis overview screen provides settings for Deployment, Channel bandwidth, Test model, Center-frequency, Reference level, and FSW attenuation.[54] |
| Choosing NR FR2 list-mode and statistical-length settings on R&S CMP200 | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation list mode allows segment-based measurement with settings such as segment length in subframes, evaluation offset in subframes, and modulation / SEM / ACLR statistical length in slots.[49] |
| Choosing NR FR1 uplink measurement bandwidth and measurement types on R&S CMX500 | CMX500 NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC measurement; multi-evaluation supports NR channel bandwidth from 3 MHz to 100 MHz and can analyze FDD/TDD, NR standalone, and intraband contiguous EN-DC signals.[53] |
### Inferences from the cited facts
【推論】Understanding OFDM time-frequency structure is needed when selecting NR-related measurement settings that are expressed in slots, subframes, OFDM symbols, subcarriers, resource elements, or channel bandwidth, because the NR frame/resource grid is defined using OFDM symbols and subcarriers, while products expose settings such as channel bandwidth, test model, slots, and subframes.[21][49][53][54]
【推論】Understanding OFDM PAPR and transform-precoding differences is relevant when deciding whether uplink measurements concern normal OFDM or low-PAPR / transform-precoded operation, because the passages state OFDM has high PAPR, NR UL can allow OFDM, and transform precoding is used to obtain low-PAPR UL transmit signals.[35][36]

NR Knowledge Base › 重點摘要
[[NR Knowledge Base]] 是一份 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 的 NR fundamentals 入口頁，定位為尋找 [[5G NR]] features、specific topics、technical notes 與 further details 的 entry point。

來源正文指出此頁只提供 [[Architecture]] 與 [[3GPP Standard]] 相關資訊；R&S specific implementation details 則應在 [[Stack]] 中查找。

來源列出 NR Stack 相關規格，包括：

- [[3GPP TS 38.101]] — User Equipment (UE) radio transmission and reception。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.212]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.213]] — Physical layer procedures for control。
- [[3GPP TS 38.214]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.321]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.331]]。

來源同頁也列出若干 R&S / 內部知識資源：

- R&S local mirror 中的 specifications PDF versions。
- [[R&S 3GPP standardization group]] / [[R&S 3GPP-Portal]]。
- [[5G PHY Training]]。
- [[5G Forum (JAM)]]。
- [[Global 5G AE Training (JAM)]]。
- [[5G eBook]] via [[GLORIS]]。
- 書籍：Chris Johnson, *5G New Radio in Bullets*, 1st Edition, 2019, ISBN 9781081444594；來源註記可向 Mai Philipp (8DSMS) 借閱。

來源最後提供 proposed subpage structure / TODO，包括 [[Frame Structure]]、[[Frequency Ranges and Bands]]、[[Phase Compensation]]、[[Split Bearer]]、[[Search Spaces]]、[[Statistics]]、[[FDD]]、[[SIB]]、[[Mobility]]、[[Carrier Aggregation]]、[[Physical Channels and Signals]]、[[Scheduling]]、[[DRX]]、[[Beams]]、[[BWP operation]]、[[Timing Alignment Groups]] 與 [[OTA]]。

NR Knowledge Base › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[3GPP TS 38.211]]、[[3GPP TS 38.212]]、[[3GPP TS 38.213]]、[[3GPP TS 38.214]]、[[3GPP TS 38.321]] 已保存各自由 feature notes 引用的 section / table 線索；本來源提供的是更上層的 NR Stack specification index。
- 既有 [[3GPP TS 38.101-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.101-2]] 分別處理 Range 1 / Range 2 standalone；本來源只列 `3GPP TS 38.101 User Equipment (UE) radio transmission and reception`，未拆分 part 1 / part 2，也未標示版本。
- 既有 [[5G NR frame structure]]、[[NR Frame Structure]] 與 [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 已對 proposed subpage structure 中的 Frame Structure 與 Frequency Ranges and Bands 提供較具體內容；本來源可作為它們在 NR Knowledge Base 中的入口索引。
- 本來源補足 [[3GPP TS 38.331]] 作為 RRC protocol specification 的來源線索。

CORESET › REG 編號
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]，[[Resource Element Group (REG)]] within a CORESET are numbered in increasing order in a time-first manner：

- 從 0 開始。
- 第一個 REG 對應 CORESET 的 first [[OFDM symbol]] 與 lowest-numbered [[Resource Block]]。
- CORESET 中的 REG 總數稱為 `NREG`。

CORESET › 定義
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]：

- A CORESET is the area in which PDCCHs are located。
- CORESET 的 dimension 由以下參數定義：
  - `frequencyDomainResources`：bitmap，每個 bit 對應 frequency domain 中一組 6 [[Resource Block]]s。
  - `duration`：1、2 或 3 個 contiguous [[OFDM symbol]]s。

因此 CORESET 同時定義 [[PDCCH]] candidate / allocation 可出現的頻率範圍與時間長度。

CORESET › unresolved
- 需要補 [[3GPP TS 38.331]] 中 `ControlResourceSet` ASN.1 IE 的正式欄位。
- 需要補 [[CORESET0]]、[[Search Space 0]] 與 initial access / SIB1 的完整關係。
- 需要確認 `precoderGranularity` 的所有正式 values、presence conditions 與 release dependencies。

Resource Element Group (REG) › 使用限制
- 本頁的 REG 定義來自 [[PDCCH (NR)]]；尚未由正式 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 全文直接驗證。
- 來源未標示 3GPP version / release。
- 本頁不涵蓋 LTE REG 或其他 channel 的 REG-like mapping，只處理 NR PDCCH / CORESET 語境。

Resource Element Group (REG) › 定義
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]：

- A REG equals one RB during one OFDM symbol。
- A REG always includes 9 data [[Resource Element]]s and 3 DMRS REs。
- REGs within a [[CORESET]] are numbered in increasing order in a time-first manner。
- Numbering starts with 0 for the first [[OFDM symbol]] and the lowest-numbered [[Resource Block]] in the CORESET。
- CORESET 中 REG 的總數稱為 `NREG`。

Resource Element Group (REG)
[[Resource Element Group (REG)]] 是 [[PDCCH]] / [[CORESET]] 內的基本 mapping unit，等於 one [[Resource Block]] during one [[OFDM symbol]]，固定包含 9 data REs 與 3 DMRS REs。

PSBCH › 承載資訊
依 [[S-SSB]]，[[PSBCH]] conveys information related to synchronization，例如：

- direct frame number（[[DFN]]）。
- sidelink transmissions 的 slot and symbol level time resources indication。
- in-coverage indicator。
- 其他 `etc.` 未展開欄位。

PSBCH › 使用限制
- 來源未提供 [[PSBCH]] payload bit layout、channel coding、rate matching、scrambling 或 modulation mapping 的完整規則。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

- PT-RS can be seen as [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] extension on selected subcarriers / [[Resource Element]]s，用來 ensure a certain time density of the reference signal on these subcarriers。
- Relevant 3GPP specifications are [[3GPP TS 38.211]] and [[3GPP TS 38.214]]；但來源未標示版本、release 或發布日期。

- [[Downlink PT-RS]] configured 時，來源說 only DMRS ports 1000-1003 / 1000-1005 will be used for [[DMRS configuration type]] 1 / 2。
- [[Uplink PT-RS]] configured 時，來源說 only DMRS ports 0-3 / 0-5 will be used for [[DMRS configuration type]] 1 / 2。

依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]，本段 applies to PTRS configuration of [[PDSCH]] and [[PUSCH]] in case of normal OFDM：

- PUSCH with transform precoding configuration will be added later；來源未提供。
- Higher layers do not specify time / frequency density directly for every PUSCH / PDSCH allocation。

依 [[PT-RS (NR)]]：

- `timeDensity` defines the maximum distance of PT-RS REs on a PT-RS subcarrier。
- Valid values are 1, 2 or 4 [[OFDM symbol]]s。
- [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] REs count as PT-RS REs。
- Primarily already mapped DMRS REs are considered。
- Additional PT-RS REs are only mapped if the distance between two DMRS is larger than the configured maximum。

### What OFDM is
The passages do not state the acronym expansion for OFDM, but they describe an OFDM signal as a waveform built from many random QAM symbols through an IFFT, which creates a high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR).[36] In 5G NR, the OFDM-based resource grid is described as time-domain OFDM symbols combined with frequency-domain subcarriers; one Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port.[21] NR numerology μ defines the OFDM time-frequency resolution by determining subcarrier spacing and OFDM symbol time duration.[78] NR sample rate for the OFDM waveform is calculated as `NFFT × SCS`, with `SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz`.[25]
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Choosing WLAN OFDM generation/analyzer options on R&S CMW100 K06 | The CMW100 K06 WLAN section lists OFDM generator standards and options for IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM, and WLAN OFDM RF analyzer options for 802.11a/g, 802.11n, 802.11p, 802.11ac, and 802.11ax.[96] |
| Choosing WLAN OFDM analyzer bandwidth and MIMO measurement capability on R&S CMW100 K06 | The CMW100 K06 WLAN OFDM RF analyzer bandwidth choices include 20 MHz, 40 MHz, 5/10/20 MHz for 802.11p, and up to 80+80 MHz / 160 MHz for 802.11ac/ax; WLAN OFDM MIMO supports switched and composite MIMO up to 8×8.[96] |
| Choosing R&S VSE measurement options for 5G NR, MIMO/beamforming, O-RAN, and LTE | The R&S VSE option list includes VSE-K144 for 5G-NR DL/UL Measurements, VSE-K146 for 5G-NR MIMO & Beamforming DL Measurements, VSE-K175 for O-RAN Measurements, VSE-K100 for LTE FDD DL/UL Measurements, and VSE-K104 for LTE TDD DL/UL Measurements.[68] |
| Choosing FSW base-station transmitter measurement mode and test type | The base-station Tx test guide says different tests require Spectrum mode or 5G NR mode; Spectrum mode is used for occupied bandwidth and transmitter spurious emissions, while 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Error/Power, Time Alignment Error, Transmit ON/OFF Power, ACLR, and SEM/OBUE.[54] |
| Setting 5G NR signal-analysis parameters such as deployment, channel bandwidth, test model, center frequency, reference level, and attenuation | The FSW 5G NR signal-analysis overview screen provides settings for Deployment, Channel bandwidth, Test model, Center-frequency, Reference level, and FSW attenuation.[54] |
| Choosing NR FR2 list-mode and statistical-length settings on R&S CMP200 | CMP200 NR FR2 multi-evaluation list mode allows segment-based measurement with settings such as segment length in subframes, evaluation offset in subframes, and modulation / SEM / ACLR statistical length in slots.[49] |
| Choosing NR FR1 uplink measurement bandwidth and measurement types on R&S CMX500 | CMX500 NR FR1 uplink measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC measurement; multi-evaluation supports NR channel bandwidth from 3 MHz to 100 MHz and can analyze FDD/TDD, NR standalone, and intraband contiguous EN-DC signals.[53] |
### Inferences from the cited facts
【推論】Understanding OFDM time-frequency structure is needed when selecting NR-related measurement settings that are expressed in slots, subframes, OFDM symbols, subcarriers, resource elements, or channel bandwidth, because the NR frame/resource grid is defined using OFDM symbols and subcarriers, while products expose settings such as channel bandwidth, test model, slots, and subframes.[21][49][53][54]
【推論】Understanding OFDM PAPR and transform-precoding differences is relevant when deciding whether uplink measurements concern normal OFDM or low-PAPR / transform-precoded operation, because the passages state OFDM has high PAPR, NR UL can allow OFDM, and transform precoding is used to obtain low-PAPR UL transmit signals.[35][36]

cited_passages.text:
5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

Low-PAPR sequence › Transform precoding 與 π/2-BPSK
依 [[DMRS]]：

- [[DFT-s-OFDM]] 也稱為 [[Transform precoding]]，在 LTE 與 NR 的 UL 中啟用，用於取得 low-PAPR UL transmit signal。
- Transform precoding 中 modulation symbols 先經 DFT-precoded，再輸入 OFDM modulator。
- DFT 與 OFDM modulator 的 IFFT block effectively cancels one another，因此移除 OFDM modulator 的 high-PAPR effect。
- 使用 low-PAPR modulation symbols 可進一步降低 UL transmit signal 的 PAPR。
- NR 中 UL transmission with transform precoding 啟用 [[π-2-BPSK]] modulation。
- [[π-2-BPSK]] 產生 low-PAPR waveform，因為 symbol-to-symbol transition 不會穿越 constellation 的 zero-amplitude point。

Low-PAPR sequence › 背景：為什麼需要 low-PAPR
依 [[DMRS]]：

- OFDM signals 具有 high peak-to-average power ratio（PAPR），因為由 many random QAM symbols 的 linear combination（IFFT）形成。
- High-PAPR signal 需要 transmitter back-off power amplifier operating point，以避免 transmit signal 進入 power amplifier saturation region 而 clipped / distorted。
- Power amplifier 遠離 saturation point 操作時 efficiency drops。
- DL signals 由連接 power grid 的 base station 傳送，因此 high-PAPR 在 DL 不 critical；NR uses OFDM for DL signals。
- NR 與 LTE 不同，NR UL 也允許使用 OFDM signals。
- UL 可能需要 low-PAPR signal，使 [[UE]] power amplifier 更接近 saturation point 並提升 efficiency，降低 UE battery energy 消耗。

CMP200 Features and Functions Version 09 › NR FR2 multi-evaluation list mode
Multi-evaluation list mode 不需要 special list mode option。List mode 允許在 measurement 期間重新設定 basic signal settings，將 measurement interval 分割為多個 segments，每個 segment 具有 constant basic signal properties。

List mode settings 抄錄：

- List mode：on/off，applies to all segments。
- Start segment：**1 to 2000**。
- No of measured segments：**1 to 1000**；每次 measurement 最多 **4000 subframes**。
- List mode offline segment number：**1 to 1000**。
- Segment length：**1 to 1000 subframes**，per segment。
- Retrigger flag：off、normal trigger source、IF power。
- Evaluation offset：**0 to 1000 subframes**。
- Modulation statistical length：**1 slot to 1000 slots**。
- Spectrum emission mask statistical length：**1 slot to 1000 slots**。
- ACLR statistical length：**1 slot to 1000 slots**。

來源說多數測試共用相同初始步驟：

5G NR numerology › 定義
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
